name: Gallery Control Buttons
author: Zeki Can

sections.description:
Gallery Control Buttons enhances WordPress galleries with advanced button controls. Visitors can easily print, download, and navigate images in a stylish Lightbox.

Features:
* Lightbox integration for gallery navigation
* Print button
* Download button
* Customizable icons and color options
* Responsive and mobile-friendly design
* Shortcode and Block support

Arbitrary Section

Support: https://zekican.net/wordpress/gallery-control-buttons
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin zip and upload it via Plugins > Add New or extract it to wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin in the WordPress admin panel under Plugins > Installed Plugins.
  3. Add [gallery_control_buttons] shortcode to your gallery pages or use it as a block.
  4. Configure settings under Media > Gallery Control Buttons.
sections.faq:
Lightbox not working, what should I do?

Check for JavaScript conflicts with your theme or other plugins. Ensure jQuery and other scripts load in the correct order.

Print and Download buttons not visible, why?

Make sure icons and color settings are saved in the plugin settings. If using a cache plugin, clear it and reload the page.
